description: Drafts a personalized check-in message for one field worker (staffId, from read the wellness queue), as Personalize on the Check-in tab does, and returns the text (draft, with ai true when the model wrote it). It saves and sends NOTHING: show the words to your person, who sends or texts them. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same draft without asking the model again.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: draft_wellness_checkin
title: Draft a wellness check-in message
